findings.current: Judging by the atmosphere, he looked ready to refuse my commission even if he had to die and come back to life.
findings.defect: The draft assigns the dying and returning to life to Jang Taebo, but the implied subject is the narrator: Jang Taebo would refuse even if the narrator died and came back.
findings.rationale: The omitted Korean subject belongs to the narrator in the idiomatic construction 죽었다 깨어나는 한이 있어도; assigning it to Jang Taebo reverses who would undergo the hypothetical ordeal.
findings.replacement: Judging by the way things were going, he wouldn’t accept my commission even if I died and came back to life.
findings.source: 이거, 지금 분위기로 봐서는 죽었다 깨어나는 한이 있어도 내 의뢰는 안 받아 줄 기세다.

findings.defect: The draft mistakes the specific Hour of the Dragon for the generic two-hour unit shichen, making the English meaningless and losing the stated time of day.
findings.rationale: 진시 is the specific traditional time period corresponding approximately to 7:00–9:00 a.m.; 시진 is the generic unit.
findings.replacement: “Already? It’s only between seven and nine in the morning.”

findings.current: I had eaten Hundred-Year Snow Ginseng before, but that had been absorbed directly by my body, so I didn’t know if it counted.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the key fact: the narrator says it was not his own body at the time, not that his body absorbed it directly.
findings.rationale: 그때는 내 몸이 아니라 explicitly states that the body involved at the time was not the narrator’s own.
findings.replacement: I had eaten Hundred-Year Snow Ginseng once, but I hadn’t been in my own body at the time, so I couldn’t say.
findings.source: 백년설삼은 먹어 본 적이 있긴 한데, 그때는 내 몸이 아니라 모르겠다.

findings.current: But Jang Taebo’s reaction was far beyond anything I expected.
findings.defect: “Far beyond” suggests that his reaction exceeded expectations, while the source says it diverged sharply from what the narrator expected.
findings.rationale: 예상을 한참 빗나갔다 means that the reaction missed or departed substantially from the narrator’s prediction, not that it surpassed it in degree.
findings.replacement: But Jang Taebo’s reaction was nothing like what I had expected.
findings.source: 하지만 장태보의 반응은 내 예상을 한참 빗나갔다.

findings.current: The shout rang out so loudly that it belied the speaker’s eighty years, and Cheongpung swallowed whatever he had been chewing.
findings.defect: The draft adds that Cheongpung had been chewing, while the source only says that something was in his mouth.
findings.rationale: 입 안에 들어 있던 것을 identifies the object only as something in his mouth; 꿀꺽 supplies the gulping action but does not establish prior chewing.
findings.replacement: The shout rang out so loudly that it belied the speaker’s eighty years, and Cheongpung gulped down whatever was in his mouth.
findings.source: 팔순이라는 나이가 무색할 만큼 쩌렁쩌렁한 고함에 청풍이 입 안에 들어 있던 것을 꿀꺽 삼켰다.

findings.defect: The unexplained romanization leaves the gambling/cardsharp joke unintelligible in English.
findings.rationale: 사쿠라 is being used as gambling-associated slang for something fake or fraudulent, reinforced by the preceding cardsharp comparison; it is not a literal reference to cherry blossoms.

findings.defect: The System item name retains square brackets, contrary to the required System-panel format.
findings.rationale: The blockquote and System heading already frame the interface, and the binding Markdown rules prohibit enclosing System UI terms in square brackets.

findings.current:
“If you bring me the Elixir of Immortality, I’ll think about it.”

“Pardon?”

“You didn’t hear me? The Elixir of Immortality. The spirit herb said to grant immortality and eternal youth.”
findings.defect: Calling 불로초 an “elixir” changes it from the spirit herb explicitly identified in the source into a prepared medicinal substance.
findings.rationale: 불로초 is a mythical herb, and the following 영초 explicitly confirms its physical category as a spirit herb.
findings.replacement:
“If you bring me the Herb of Eternal Youth, I’ll think about it.”

“Pardon?”

“You didn’t hear me? The Herb of Eternal Youth—the spirit herb said to grant eternal youth and immortality.”
findings.source:
“불로초를 구해 오면 생각해 보지.”

“예?”

“못 들었나? 불로초 말일세. 불로장생을 가져다준다는 영초.”

findings.current: Quest **[In Search of the Elixir of Immortality]** has been created.
findings.defect: The Quest title repeats the incorrect “elixir” terminology and retains prohibited square brackets.
findings.rationale: The title refers to the same 불로초 identified as a spirit herb in the dialogue, while the binding System-panel rules require removal of the square brackets.
findings.replacement: Quest **In Search of the Herb of Eternal Youth** has been created.

summary: Actionable fidelity errors include two reversed subjects or actions, a lost time quantity, misleading terminology, an untranslated gambling reference, and prohibited System-panel brackets.
